title: Cross-Product Guidance — The System Share of a Guarantee Shortfall, Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# The System Share of a Guarantee Shortfall

Guidance on the share of a measured shortfall carried at the building's controls standing when a payment is made under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions, where the same building also holds a plan under Building Automation Service Plans. The unmanaged share is 60 percent, the part supported share 80 percent and the whole of the shortfall 100 percent.

## Rule

Where the building holds no automation service plan in active or renewal standing, the system share is the unmanaged share, because the sequences the saving depends on are not being kept. Where the building holds such a plan and the support hours standing on it for its plan year are exhausted, the system share is the part supported share. In every other case the system share is the whole of the shortfall.

## What decides it

Two figures are read from the plan the building holds under Building Automation Service Plans: its standing, and the support hours still standing on it for its plan year.

| Plan at the building | Support hours standing for its plan year | System share |
|---|---|---|
| none, or in any standing other than active or pending renewal | any | 60 percent |
| active or pending renewal | exhausted — nothing or less remains | 80 percent |
| active or pending renewal | hours still stand | 100 percent |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A building whose automation plan stands in its renewal window with 7.5 support hours left carries the whole of the shortfall at 100 percent. With those hours drawn to nothing, 80 percent. With the plan suspended, expired or never held, 60 percent.
